import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Rebuild docker
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && docker-compose build --no-cache 2>&1 > /tmp/docker-build.log & echo started")
print("Build started")
time.sleep(3)
client.close()
EOF
